status: PROVISIONAL. Numeric thresholds must be agreed with the QA lead and recorded in the requirements matrix before any model serves Tier 2 workflows. Values below are placeholders chosen by the author.

baseline_floor._comment: Regression guard for the OFFLINE baselines (hashing embedder, local provider, regex extractor). Enforced by --check in CI. Not a quality bar for models.

tier2_targets._comment: Informational for model runs: what a model should reach to be considered for Tier 2 (drafts for regulated records).
